weekLabel.zh: 本周更新 · 9 月 7 日 – 9 月 13 日

title.zh: 全球解锁时刻表曝光：63 个地区分批开服，新西兰最早、美英垫底
title.en: Global unlock times surface: 63 regions roll out in waves, New Zealand first

summary.zh: PS Store 页面显示 11 月 19 日各地时间午夜 0 点分批解锁，新西兰比墨西哥与中美洲早 19 小时进入罪恶城；因首发不含实体光盘，所有玩家都受平台排程约束。
summary.en: PlayStation Store listings show a midnight-local unlock on Nov 19 across 63 regions — New Zealand gets in 19 hours before Mexico and Central America. With no disc at launch, everyone is bound by the platforms' schedule.

title.zh: 索尼 State of Play 公布两款 GTA6 限定 DualSense，9 月 10 日开预售
title.en: Two GTA 6 limited-edition DualSense controllers revealed at State of Play

summary.zh: 白色限量版与 Vice City 深色版两款，$84.99，9 月 10 日开启预售、11 月 19 日与游戏同日发售，全球限量发售。
summary.en: A white Limited Edition and a Vice City–inspired dark variant land at $84.99, with pre-orders opening Sep 10 and release on Nov 19 alongside the game — in limited quantities worldwide.

title.zh: Rockstar 确认枪械携带规则：两把隐蔽手枪，长枪必须外露
title.en: Rockstar confirms gun-carry rules: two concealed pistols, visible long guns

summary.zh: Rob Nelson 确认主角可常备两把隐蔽手枪；长枪最多两把且必须可见——背上一把、手上一把，不能两把都背。NPC 与警察会对公开持械分级反应，多余武器可存进车辆或 Ammu-Nation 枪柜。
summary.en: Rob Nelson confirms two always-concealed handguns, while long guns stay visible — one on the back, one in hand. NPCs and police react in tiers to open carry, and spare weapons live in vehicles or Ammu-Nation lockers.

title.zh: 开发总监：GTA6 不追求照片级真实，“目标是给人真实的感觉”
title.en: Dev boss: GTA 6 isn't chasing photorealism — “the goal is to feel real”

summary.zh: Rockstar North 开发总监 Rob Nelson 接受法媒采访时表示，画面当然会更好，但“完全真实不是我们的目标”，美术风格优先于技术参数的堆叠。
summary.en: Rockstar North's Rob Nelson says the visuals will improve, but photorealism “isn't the goal” — art direction takes priority over piling on technical specs.
